title: Cake Stack
tagline: Stack yummy cake layers into a giant birthday cake for your animal friends!
howToPlay: Each birthday friend orders a cake in pictures, from the bottom layer to the top: listen to the order, then wait for the matching layer and tap, click or press Space to drop it when it lines up. Layers the order doesn't need yet just slide past. Later friends order patterns like strawberry, mint, strawberry, mint. Blow out the candles, then share the cake fairly: give every friend the same number of slices. Choose 🎂 Free stacking to drop any layer, or open Recipe studio to build pictured recipes and share equal slices.
learning: Sequencing, patterns, counting and equal sharing
